app.title: Neural Machine Translation
brand.name: Montage Subtitle Translator
app.tagline: Machine translation that reads each scene in context and keeps your timing intact.
app.feature.1.title: Pro tools, open to everyone
app.feature.1.desc: A labor of love from the MontageSubs community. We’ve baked fansubbing standards, workflows, and typography into a nonprofit, open-source tool. No fluff—just a simple way to get subtitles that actually look right and read naturally.
app.feature.2.title: Beyond Line-by-Line
app.feature.2.desc: Subtitles are living dialogue, not isolated lines. By optimizing the input structure, we help the engine grasp the scene’s pacing and rhythm. Combined with glossaries and QA, it keeps your terms consistent and timing precise.
app.feature.3.title: Clean and Direct
app.feature.3.desc: No installation. No accounts. No ads, no paywalls, no tracking. We’ve stripped away the noise and all the BS. Just a straightforward tool to get your subtitles translated, fast and clean.

a11y.sourceReset: Original language reset to auto-detect because it matched the translation language.
a11y.targetChanged: Translation language changed to {language} because it matched the original language.
model.google.desc: Processes full-scene context in batches, preserving consistency across lines.
model.microsoft.desc: Fast and broad language support. Translates short sentence windows, offering less cross-line continuity.
model.deepl.desc: High-quality translation, but API costs currently exceed what our nonprofit service can support.
model.llm.desc: Costs roughly 50 times more than standard NMT, which our free service cannot cover alone.
model.more.title: More engines
model.more.desc: Large language models and on-device engines.
model.local.title: On-device engines
model.local.desc: Engines that run on your own device are in development. Have one in mind?
glossary.label: Glossary
glossary.desc: Terms listed here are always translated as you specify.
glossary.bulkSourcePlaceholder: One term per line, e.g. manzana
glossary.bulkTargetPlaceholder: One translation per line, in the same order, e.g. apple
caseSensitiveTerms.label: Match capitalization
caseSensitiveTerms.desc: When enabled, matches only terms with identical capitalization.
tip.glossaryBulk: Paste many terms at once, one per line in each box
tip.importGlossary: Reuse the glossary from a previous translation
context.label: Context (optional)
context.placeholder: e.g. Two rival captains negotiate a truce. The mood is tense but formal.
context.desc: Provides story, character, and scene background notes. Enter context directly. This is not an AI prompt.
context.microsoftNote: Microsoft Translator does not support context. Each request processes one or two sentences at a time.
context.tooLong: Only the first {max} characters are sent.
context.willTranslate: Detected as {code}. It will be translated into the original language first.
tip.importContext: Reuse the context from a previous translation
scene.label: Scene gap (seconds)
scene.hint: Lines closer together than this threshold share scene context. Too short fragments context, while too long blurs scene focus. 30 seconds works well for most film and TV.
sdh.label: Remove SDH / hearing-impaired captions
sdh.desc: Strips sound descriptions, ambient effects, and speaker identifiers from captions (SDH/HI). Applies only to supported source languages.
lyrics.label: Don’t translate lyrics
lyrics.desc: Keeps lyrics marked with music notes (such as ♪) in the original language.
outputMode.bilingualDesc: Shows the original and the translation together, for studying or proofreading.
outputMode.monolingualDesc: Shows only the translation for a cleaner screen.
stacking.note: Sets the stacking order of bilingual subtitles, choosing whether the translation or original language appears on top.
cueLayout.note: Stacked groups both languages at the bottom of the screen. Split places one at the top and one at the bottom (supported by ASS and WebVTT, while SRT falls back to stacked).
tip.layoutSingle: Both languages in one subtitle block
tip.layoutSplit: Each language at its own position on screen (ASS and WebVTT only)
musicTopAlign.label: Show lyrics at the top
musicTopAlign.desc: Moves lyrics to the top-left of the screen to prevent overlap with dialogue subtitles at the bottom. Enabled by default for Chinese, Japanese, and Korean.
punctuation.fullWidth.label: Keep full-width ！ and ？
punctuation.fullWidth.desc: Replaces full-width ！ and ？ with half-width punctuation for compact subtitle spacing. Turn on to preserve full-width marks.
punctuation.terminators.label: Keep periods and commas
punctuation.terminators.desc: Removes sentence-final periods and commas for a cleaner screen presentation. Turn on to preserve translated punctuation.
credit.label: Support this project
credit.desc: Adds a short credit at the end of your subtitles to help others find this open-source tool.
credit.text: Subtitles generated by Montage Subtitle Translator
ass.sizeNote: Sets font sizes when exporting to ASS subtitles. Choose desktop or mobile presets, or customize sizes.
ass.equalSizeDesc: Uses equal font sizes for both languages. When turned off, the secondary language is scaled down to emphasize the main line.
tip.sizeLocked: Choose Custom to edit the sizes
tip.secondaryLocked: Unavailable with one language, or when both languages share one size

error.networkError: Couldn’t reach the translation service. Check your connection and try again.
error.timeout: This is taking too long. Check your connection and try again.
error.outputBlocked: The engine’s response was blocked by a safety check, so translation stopped. Try again, or switch engines.
error.invalidRequest: Something went wrong with this request. Please try again.
error.unsupportedLanguage: This engine doesn’t support that language yet. Try another language or engine.
error.verificationFailed: Verification didn’t go through. Please try again.
error.verificationRequired: Please complete a quick verification to continue.
error.capacityExceeded: This free service has reached its capacity for today. It’s not caused by you. Please try again later.
error.payloadTooLarge: This file is too large to process right now.
error.rateLimited: Too many requests at once. Wait a moment and try again.
error.quotaExceeded: You’ve reached the fair-use limit for now, which keeps this service free for everyone. Please try again later.

captcha.error: Verification couldn’t load. This may be a temporary network issue.
